title: userVerification preferred, no unlock in five minutes and no PIN or PRF: the answer has UV = 0 and a click is all it takes

unsafe.definition: the response has user verification set although nothing verified this request (no recent unlock, no PRF, PIN or master password)
the response has user presence set without a trusted click in Ferret's own window or popup

note: The only case that sees UV = 1 without a verification from outside. Changed after review U4-13: SimpleWebAuthn instead of webauthn-rs, which refuses UV = 0 for a passkey registered with UV (the strict-RP note of UK107); the steps say what "no possible verification" is: no server, the PIN's last contact more than seven days ago, no recent unlock.
